fact: Artifacts crossing a trust boundary carry a content hash and an attestation, and verification runs against the attestation rather than against a claim.
Prose claims are tested like code: a frozen pattern per claim is checked against bytes in CI, and drift fails the build.
Accepted decision records are immutable; reversals are written as new records linked by a superseded-by reference.
Competing candidates for canonical status resolve by a deterministic weighted rule, and stale-term claims are ignored.
Every state transition produces an immutable generation closure with an atomic switch and a one-step rollback to the previous closure.
Rollback covers only managed state, and mutable live state is named as outside the guarantee.
Every long-lived switch or organ registers an owner and a purpose, is audited on a schedule, and its removal routes to the owner.
Alerts fire on consumer-visible symptoms with deduplication and inhibition, and escalate by budget burn rate rather than per cause.
Deleting a mechanism requires a reachability check from named entry points.
Documentation style is enforced by a shared prose linter configuration.
